segments.name: Medical devices
segments.description: Designs and sells medical devices, including exoskeletons and rehabilitation systems, for physical rehabilitation and recovery in clinics and at home.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Clinics, distributors, third-party payors, sports teams and self-pay individuals pay the company for its rehabilitation devices and related warranties and services.
revenueModel.evidence: We have in the past generated and expect to generate in the future revenue from a combination of clinics and rehabilitation centers, commercial distributors, third-party payors (including private and government payors), professional and college sports teams, and self-pay individuals.
